label: A being's act of being is exercised at exactly the points where it exists
paraphrase: OPEN (the act-fact link), analyst formulation: for every point v and being x, x's represented esse is in act at v (its act of being is exercised there, WORLD_RELATIVE_EXISTENCE_METAPHYSICAL_ESSE_NECESSITY_6) if and only if x exists at v (the world-relative existence fact, _1). The explicit passage from esse as act to existence as fact; ST I q.3 a.4 ad 2 (read) distinguishes 'to be' as the act of essence from 'to be' as the composition of a proposition. Accepted by the unconditional and the existence-conditional essentialist alike (controls, models kantAquinas and conditionalIdentity); a view that rejects the act of being as a principle (the quantifier view of existence) rejects its left side as empty, not the equivalence.
